source: Owner answers to four multiple-choice questions asked in the planning session of 2026-11-16, followed by owner approval of the plan (research/production_loop_20261116/PLAN_KO.md). The selected option labels are quoted verbatim.

decisions.meaning: Merge on a separate integration branch; adopt only if the 1.94.1 build, the full tests and bitwise identity of the protected RODAS5P paths pass; otherwise port additive modules only. Ledger rows backed by simulation scripts get superseding INVALID rows; existing rows are kept.
decisions.gate_effect: Explicit conditional owner approval for the protected-blob changes that the merge brings (MUTATION_GATES immutable list), valid only if the stated conditions hold; the blob delta list is reported in the wave report.

decisions.meaning: One pre-registered decision experiment (sigma_max=1.5 stability with the independent oracle, per-step cost at equal implementation maturity, large-n regime with reference to the REI 46k run); freeze as opt-in comparator if the criteria fail.

Registry-based single entry point, explicit method choice, opt-in Auto policy and typed fallback with charged work and preserved prefix. Default routing and protected RODAS5P unchanged; promotion is a separate decision.
G0 stays unchanged. A separate release-readiness gate (R-gate) for the scoped package with protected RODAS5P as default is defined and judged per axis.

decisions.topic: adoption of the trial merge of 93392249 although the frozen rule is formally not met
decisions.asked_after: wave 1 gates: T1 PASS, T5 PASS, T2 1210 passed / 2 failed (source-pinning sentinels g3, h2), T3 strict FAIL by 600 added serde keys with 0 changed values, T6 FAIL
decisions.meaning: Adopt the merge on the loop branch. Re-pin sentinels g3 and h2 to the post-merge bytes with a record of old and new pins; regenerate the one golden file whose only difference is added keys; add INVALID superseding rows for L-0209..L-0214; the unified router defects are handled in V03 (real dispatch or removal); hook settings are not edited, only reported.

decisions.topic: declaration of loop modules in rodas5p-integrators/src/lib.rs
decisions.meaning: The owner allowlist of sentinel g3 is extended: besides `pub mod ppsw1;` the file may hold the loop L1 module lines; the allowed lines are named in the test.
Open a draft pull request from the loop branch to research/production-unification-20261115, titled as not a release, never merged by the agent, to run production.yml.

decisions.topic: evidence branches v15 and trial whose push was denied by the permission classifier
decisions.meaning: The owner pushes research/production-loop-20261116-v15 and -trial manually; the agent does not retry.

decisions.topic: kernel of the facade's banded route (Indexed today; the Slices kernel of the same file returns identical bits with 0.16-0.22 of the instructions on wide bands, node V21)
decisions.meaning: The facade's banded route may use the Slices kernel. Results must stay bit-identical; the kernel is chosen so that narrow bands do not become slower. The protected file may be edited for this change only; sentinels and the checkpoint are re-pinned with this decision.

decisions.topic: defect of Rodas5p::capabilities found by node V03 part A and its review (a general sparse-JVP provider is admitted on the sequential route although the driver refuses it; 352 distinct grid plans cannot run)
decisions.meaning: The defect is fixed: the capability answer must name what runs, and what cannot run is refused before any callback. Golden files that record the old answer are re-pinned with a documented difference.

decisions.topic: restart length (40) and residual-test cadence (once per cycle) of the protected matrix-free driver (node V17 and its review)
decisions.meaning: The restart length and the cadence of the residual test of the protected matrix-free stage solve become adaptive. Frozen discriminators are pre-registered before any run; the original stage residual must pass in every solve.

decisions.topic: items that were waiting since the hosted CI triage: workflow edits, version 0.2.0 for the semver job, push of the branches -v15 and -trial
decisions.selected: 4. 수정 승인. 자동 push 가능하게 교정.
decisions.meaning: The workflow edits of ci/TRIAGE_KO.md and the version bump to 0.2.0 are approved. The agent sets up the permission so that pushes of the research branches are not blocked, and pushes research/production-loop-20261116-v15 and -trial itself. This replaces OD-L1-8.

decisions.topic: ledger rows L-0317 to L-0320, which break the row schema (claim longer than 600 characters; verdict KILL), reported to the owner at 22:30
decisions.selected: 1. 제자리 수정 허용. append-only 원칙은 유연하게 적용하고 고정된 원칙으로 사용하지 말것
decisions.meaning: The four rows are corrected in place. The append-only rule of the ledger is applied with judgment and is not a fixed rule.

decisions.topic: research/qualification/, adopted with the switcher lineage without pre-registration and without a ledger row (open since the hosted CI triage)
decisions.meaning: The files that are needed stay in the tree.

decisions.topic: default of the matrix-free stage solve after node V24 (frozen verdict FAIL by rule B; the variant P1, not chosen by V24, had the budget counts of the shipped policy on the seen grid)
decisions.selected: 1. P1을 새 문제로 재시험 후 결과에 따라 경제적인 방향으로 adaptive로 전환여부 결정.
decisions.meaning: P1 is re-tested on problem families not used before; by the results the matrix-free route switches to the adaptive policy if that is the economical choice (node V25).

decisions.topic: default of the pattern check of the opt-in client AssemblyStageClient (node V08, review finding F-01: 8 sampled columns are not fail-closed in general)
decisions.selected: 2. n회 추가가 벡터화/병렬화가 가능한지 먼저 시험
decisions.meaning: Before the default is decided, test whether the n additional right-hand sides of the full check can be vectorized or parallelized (node V26).

decisions.topic: Auto route of the unified router (node V03 part B): the constants 1000, 10 and 3.3 B, the rule for a supplied derivative, the off-trajectory probes of the stiffness screen
decisions.meaning: The route is redesigned so that as few hyperparameters as possible remain (node V27). Ruling of the agent: the design is presented to the owner before it is implemented, because it changes the behaviour of the route.

decisions.topic: split of the ignored-tests job (measurement programs against contract tests)
decisions.selected: 4. 필요한 경우 먼저 설명하고 지시 승인 후 진행
decisions.meaning: If a split is needed, the agent first explains it and changes the workflows only after the owner approves.

decisions.topic: CI test jobs (answer to the split of the ignored-tests job, item 4 of 2026-11-24)
decisions.selected: test job은 누적해서 실행하지 말고 새로 실행해야 하는 것이나 이전 변경에 영향받는 것만 재실행하는 방향으로 수정. full suite는 최종 release 전에 실행 예정.
decisions.meaning: The CI test jobs no longer re-run the whole suite at every push: they run new tests and the tests that the changes since the last complete run can affect. The whole suite runs before the final release. Supersedes the split proposed for the ignored-tests job (options A and B).

plan_approval.includes: commit and standalone push of research branches of this loop after each wave

not_authorized: change of G0, tolerances or protected RODAS5P controller constants
change of the PPSW1 default sigma cap
